title: Crossly Automation Recipe (v1)
description: Portable JSON shape for an automation rule. Used by the /api/automation/rules/import endpoint and the github.com/alphajew420/crossly-automations community library. Trigger / action / condition `type` values must match an entry in the live catalog at /api/automation/catalog.

$schema.description: Optional self-reference to this schema URL.

schemaVersion.description: Recipe schema version. Bumped only on breaking changes.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the import preview and rules list.

condition.description: Optional condition gate. Omit, or set type to 'none', to fire on every trigger.

platforms.description: Optional platform scope. When set, the rule only acts on listings/conversations on these platforms.

metadata.description: Community-library metadata. Server ignores; UI may render.

config.description: Type-specific configuration. Shape defined per trigger/action/condition in the catalog.
